tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// rnam 'joms rgyud kyi gsal byed 'od zer can bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ don dam ston byed nus pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// rdo rje 'dzin cing gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i// zhabs pad dri med spyi bos blangs byas nas// dri med rgyud don rab tu gsal bar bya// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ zab mo'i don gyi mdo sde/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ 'di la thog mar brgyud pa'i byung tshul bshad par bya'o// lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na gnyis te/ gzhung bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ bshad pa'i lo rgyus so// dang po bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku tshe'i smad la/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'di bsgyur te/ bod du bsgyur ba la 'di snga ba yin no// rgyal po de'i sras mang srong mang btsan/ de'i sras gung srong gung btsan/ de'i sras 'du srong mang po rje 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ de'i sras khri sde gtsug brtan no// de yan chad gdung rabs lnga la/ bod na sdom pa dang ldan pa'i rab tu byung ba'am/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'dri klog slob pas chos kyi gra tshugs pa yin te/ mdo 'di kun thams cad kyang bri ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed pa yod pa yin skad/ de'i sras khri srong sde btsan gyi sku ring la/ lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun byung ste/ rgan gsum/ gzhon gsum/ bar pa ni btsun pa ye shes dbang po bya ba yin te/ de dang bdun no// rgan gsum ni dbas mañju shrī dang*/ gtsang shī lan+d+ra dang*/ bran ka mu ki ta'o// gzhon gsum ni/ pa gor bai ro tsa na dang*/ 'khon klu'i dbang po dang*/ gtsang de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi ta'o// de rnams kyis rnam dag khrims khang gling du/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la spyan drangs te/ khrims blangs pas rnam dag khrims khang gling zhes bya'o// de nas sngags 'chang dharma kīrti zhes bya ba spyan drangs te/

btsad po de nyid thog mar rdo rje dbyings dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas bdud 'dul sngags pa gling zhes bya'o// de nas mar rab tu byung ba thams cad kyang khrims dang ldan par byas la sngags pa rnams kyang dbang thob par byas so// de nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra spyan drangs nas/ sad mi mi bdun gyis lo tsā ba byas te/ rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa'i rgyud sde mang po bsgyur bas/ sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling zhes bya'o// gzhan yang mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du sgom byed/ dkor mdzod pe kar gling du nor 'jog brda sbyor tshangs pa gling du brda sbyor/ de'i dus na bod kyi so so'i skye bo thams cad thun mong gi dge sbyor gzungs 'di la byed pa paṇ+ḍi tas gzigs pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi khro bo dang khro mo thams cad kyi sngags 'don pa yin pas/ dbang bskur dang dam tshig ma thob pa rnams kyi thun mong du kha ton la sogs pa byas pa ma legs/ chos la brten pa'i sdig pa 'ong gsungs nas/ sngar bton pa'i bshags par sdig pa sbyong ba la shis pa 'phags pa rtog pa chen po'i mdo 'gyod tshangs kyi le'u'i mdo nas bton nas 'don du bcug phyis kyi thun mong gi dge sbyor/ dam tshig dang dbang bskur ma thob pa dang*/ thob pa rnams kyis 'don du rung ba'i mdo/ shes rab snying po bsgyur nas 'don du bcug de yang de'i don shes dgos pas shes snying rgya cher 'grel pa yang mdzad/ bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus so// gnyis pa bshad pa'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgya gar gyi yul na rgyal po log pa'i snying po zhes bya ba cig yod pa las/ de'i snying du lha'i bu'i bdud zhugs nas mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs te/ lha khang dang pusti thams cad bsregs/ dge slong la sogs pa la la bsad skad/

rgyal po des de ltar byas pas bstan pa la dga' ba'i srung ma gtsang ris ka mgon po rnams khros/ mi ma yin pa'i gdon thams cad 'khrugs te/ yul khams der char mi 'bab pa dang*/ yams nad sna tshogs pa dang*/ bkra mi shes pa sna tshogs byung*/ rgyal po rang nad sha bkras zin nas/ sdug bsngal dang ldan par gyur to// rgyal po de'i don du rgyal po sde bzhis/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa shing sā la'i drung na chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po log pa'i snying po nad sha bkras zin pa las thar pa'i thabs zhus pas/ rgyal po log pa'i snying po sde dang 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dregs pa can du 'dug pas zhi ba'i skus mi thul te/ drag po'i sku'i gdul byar 'dug gsungs nas mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje chen pos phyag na rdo rje la bskul lo// de yang gzhung 'di nyid las/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus zhes pas shes so// phyag na rdo rjes kyang zhi bas mi thul bar gzigs nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po las byung ba'i khro bo chen por sprul nas bshad do// de yang gzhung las rdo rje khro bo las byung ba zhes pas shes so// bshad pa ni mi chod pa la sogs pa nar mar ro// thugs rgyud ye shes su snang ba'i phyag na rdo rje des bshad nas/ sdud pa po phyag na rdo rjes gzhung bsdus so// des rgyal po bzhi la bshad/ des log pa'i snying po la bshad/ rgyal po sde bzhi dang log pa'i snying po 'khor dang bcas pas nyams su blangs pas/ sngar gyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur to// de yang gzhung las/ rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /ces pa dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed// ces pas shes so// 'di la bshad srol mang yang jo bo rin chen bzang pos bshad pa ste/ brgyud pa'i dbang du byas na/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis phyag na rdo rje la/ des rgyal po sde bzhi la/

des log pa'i snying po la/ log pa'i snying pos grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr/ a ro pa bsam gtan bcu gnyis pa la bshad/ yang phyag na rdo rje de nyid kyis a ro pa bsam gtan bcu gnyis pa la bshad/ des rdo rje go cha la/ des yul dbus kyi dza ya se na la/ des nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje la/ des shrad+dhā ka ra warma la/ des rin chen bzang po la/ des mnga' ris kyi shud pu yon legs la/ des gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab la/ des gnur nyi ma 'od zer la/ des bla ma sa skya pa la/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus so// de ltar brgyud pa'i mdo 'di/ chos thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus pa las bka' yin no// de gnyis su 'dus par cis shes na/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel par mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang*// de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes pas shes so// bka' la yang gsum ste/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang*/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang*/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' 'o// byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' ni ston pa zhal bzhugs tsa na/ de'i byin rlabs kyis ston pa dang*/ nyan pa po'am bems po'am/ dud 'gro la sogs pas kyang chos kyi sgra sgrogs shes pa la sogs pa'o// de'ang sdud pa las/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang*// zhes pa nas/ skyes bu'i mthu'i bar du'o// rjes su gnang ba'i bka' ni ston pa mya ngan las 'das tsam na/ gong du 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes pa dang*/ bar du de nas zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa zhes pa dang*/ mthar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// zhes pa la sogs pa chug cig ces gsungs pa ni rjes su gnang ba'i bka' 'o// bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis zhal nas gsungs pa ni/

dngos su gnang ba'i bka' 'o// gzungs 'di la gsum ka yod de/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa nas snyoms par zhugs so'i bar/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' 'o// de nas lag na rdo rje zhes pa nas/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba'i bar ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' 'o// mi chod pa man chad ni zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' 'o// yang chos thams cad bslab pa rin po che gsum du 'du ste/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ shes rab dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gsum las/ mdo 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab par 'dus te/ 'di nyid las/ mdo sde 'di ni mnyan byed na// zhes so// yang gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ 'di gang du'ang ma lhung par thams cad du 'gro ste/ 'di nyid las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// zhes gsungs pas so// de lta bu'i brjod bya'i don ci yin zhe na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs par dka' ba/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin te/ 'di nyid las/ zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// zhes 'byung bas so// de lta bu'i mdo sde de la rgya skad bod skad du sbyar nas/ mtshan bstan pa ni/ rgyal po'i bka' rtags kyi phyag rgyas btab pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos khungs btsun pa dang*/ btsal sla ba dang*/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la bag chags bzhag pa dang*/ byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba dang*/ mtshan bklags pas bar chad sel ba dang*/ sgra thang klog la mkhas par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ni sangs rgyas ni rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug byang chub sems dpa' ni sa bcu gcig man chad rtogs pa'i khyad par la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'o// 'di skad ces pa la sogs pas gleng gzhi bstan te/ 'di skad ces pa chos phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ bdag gis thos pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang*/

dus gcig na zhes pa dus phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das las thos zhes pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rdo rje la bzhugs pa las thos zhes gnas phun sum tshogs pa'o// thos pa kun la sbyar te/ de yang 'di skad ces bya ba 'og nas 'chad pa'i gzhung thams cad do// de ston pa rdo rje'i tshig 'di skad dang*/ de'i don 'di skad ces/ 'di kho na skad thos kyi phri ba dang bsnan pa med do zhes pa'i don to// bdag gis thos zhes pa ni bdag nyid yin par ston te/ 'di gzhan las brgyud pa med pa dngos su thos pa bstan te/ thos zhes bya ba rna ba'i dbang po skyon med par ma yengs par mnyam par bzhag nas shes pa ma 'khrul bar thos pa'o// yang thos pa'i shes rab kyis thos kyi rtogs pas ni ma yin no// dus gcig na thos zhes bya ba ni/ dus gcig gi tshe 'di thos kyi/ dus gzhan du gzhan yang thos zhes pas thos pa mang bar bstan nas/ yang dus gcig nyid la 'di thos shing khung du chud pas shes rab che zhing*/ tshad ma'i skyes bur ston pa'o// yang rgyud 'di lan cig las ma gsungs pas 'byung bar dka' zhing zab par yang bstan to// bcom ldan 'das zhes pas nyon mongs pa dang*/ lha'i bu dang*/ phung po'i dang*/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dang bzhi bcom pas na bcom ldan 'das te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ nyon mongs las dang de bzhin skye// de bzhin nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib// mi mthun phyogs kyi chos rnams gang*// de bcom pas na bcom ldan brjod// ces gsungs so// de lta bu de rang su yin na phyag na rdo rje'o// phyag na rdo rje la gsum du bzhed de/ thugs rgyud ye shes su snang ba'i phyag na rdo rje dang*/ lam rgyud 'phags par snang ba dang*/ 'gro rgyud sems can du snang ba'o// dang po ni sangs rgyas thams cad mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje chen po las byung ba/ sa bcu gcig pa'i rtogs pa mthar phyin pa/

gdul bya gdug pa can 'dul ba la khro bor snang ba'o// gnyis pa ni sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'o// gsum pa ni gang zag gi blos phyag na rdo rjer bsgoms na rang la dmigs pa gsal yang gzhan gyis phyag na rdo rjer mi mngon te/ sems can du snang ngo*// don la bdag sems can yin yang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'o// gsum po de yi nang nas rgyud 'di'i ston pa ni thugs rgyud ye shes su snang ba'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ rdo rje la bzhugs te zhes pas gnas ston pa'i tshig ste/ phyi'i gnas ri rab kyi zom mam/ rdo rje'i gdan yin la nang gi gnas ni rdo rje sa bcu gcig pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi dbyings stong par rtogs pa'o// de la ci'i phyir rdo rje zhes bya zhe na rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// gcad dang gzhig par bya ba med// bsreg par byar med 'jig med pa// stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya// 'gro drug 'khor lo g.yo byed cing*// sdig pa grol bar byed pa'i mchog /ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pas gleng gzhi'i bshad pa'o// gzhung las rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// zhes pas sngon byung ston pa ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pa dang*/ rjes 'jug dmigs pa lha la gtad pa dang*/ gtor ma la gtad pa bstan to// sems can thams cad srung ba/ zhi ba la sogs pas sbyin sreg bstan/ nor bu yongs kar dūr ba la sogs pas bum pa la gtad pa bstan to// sngags kyi mgor na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dpung bzang le'u bcu pa las/ srid gsum nang na rgyal ba dkon mchog ste// de yi 'og tu de las byung ba'i chos// de bzhin dge 'dun skyes chen brgyad po ste// srid pa gsum na dkon mchog gsum po gtso// 'di gsum bsod nams rnam par 'phel rgyu yin// dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags mgo la gdon// zhes gsungs so// gzhung gi bshad pa mdor bstan pa'o// da ni mngon rtogs phyogs gcig tu bstan par bya ste/

de la bzhi/ dmigs pa yi dam gyi lha la gtad pa dang*/ bum pa la gtad pa dang*/ gtor ma la gtad pa dang*/ sbyin sreg la gtad pa'o// de yang gzhung nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ zhes gsungs pas de ni/ skad sor bzhag pa yin te/ de bsgyur bas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa yin pas/ skyabs 'dzin la/ gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*// zhes pas byang chub kyi sems dang*/ tshad med bzhi 'dzin/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// zhes pas de'i rjes la stong pa nyid bsgom pa bstan/ de nas phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba la sogs pas sku phyag rgya chen po gsal gdab pa bstan/ de dag gi mngon par rtogs pa ni 'di yin te/ rang gzhan gyi bar chad bsal ba dang*/ bde ba bsgrub pa'i ched du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ mngon par rtogs pa nyams su blang ba la don bco lnga ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa dang*/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa dang*/ bdag lhar bskyed pa dang*/ mdun du lha bsgom pa dang*/ de dag gi thugs kar sngags dgod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang ba dang*/ de dag gi thugs kar sngags dgod pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pa dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pa bya ba dang*/ brtan par bya ba dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ mdun gyi de rang la bsdu ba dang*/ bsrung ba byas la ci bder spyad pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du sangs rgyas dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi'o// chos dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes mos pa bya'o// de nas gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal thams cad bsal nas sangs rgyas thob par bya'o// snyam du mos pa bya'o// gsum pa tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'i dang po byams pa bsgom pa ni/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang phrad par 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa snying rje ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar 'dod pa'o// gsum pa dga' ba ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba dang phrad par gyur na dga' ba'o// bzhi pa btang snyoms ni/ sems can thams cad la chags sdang gnyis dang bral nas mnyam par mos pa'o// bzhi pa snod bcud kyi sems can thams cad stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ sems rtse gcig tu mi rtog pa bsgom pa'o// lnga pa bdag lhar bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon nam/ ljang ser phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu rked pa'i phyogs su 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bdag nyid bsgom mo// drug pa mdun du lha bskyed pa ni/ ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyag na rdo rje rang 'dra ba cig mdun du bsgom mo// bdun pa sngags dgod pa ni gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su phyag na rdo rje'i ming gi yi ge dang po'am hūm̐ bsams la de'i rjes la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// nas bzung nas rab tu smras so yan chad brjod pa sngon du song bas/ bdag dang mdun gyi lha gsal gdab/ de nas na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar lan cig brjod pas/ rang dang mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du rtsa sngags/ de'i nang du khro bo bcu'i sngags/ de'i nang du yang snying bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bkod de/ de thams cad kha dog dkar po'i rnam pa mgo phyir bstan pa'am/

gyen du langs pa skyes pa lta bu 'od 'phros pa bsam mo// brgyad pa spyan drang ba ni/ sngags gnyis pa brjod pas/ he phul+lu'i sgras rang dang mdun gyi thugs ka'i yi ge las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs te/ khro bo ma yin pa rnams kyang khro bor bsgyur nas/ rang gi phyogs mtshams thams cad du lhags par bsam mo// dgu pa de dag gi thugs kar sngags dgod pa ni/ sngags gsum pa brjod pas spyan drangs pa de dag gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ bsams la/ de la sngags bdag dang mdun gyi lha la sum rim gyis bkod pa bzhin du dgod do// bcu pa sngags bzlas pa ni/ bzlas pa'i dus su gsum ka tshang bar bzlas pa'am/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum gang rung bzlas pa'o// de yang grangs ni/ lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ ces 'byung bas tshang bar zlos na nyer gcig snying po'am yang snying zlos na brgya rtsa brgyad/ de yang gsum ka tshang bar zlos na he phul+lu'i sgras bskul nas thugs ka nas 'od zer spro'o// snying po dang nye snying zlos pa la/ sngags de nyid brjod pa'i sgras bskul nas 'od zer spro'o// 'od zer phar 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus thugs ka'i yi ge la thim pas yi ge thams cad bkrag dang gzi mdangs dang ldan par byas nas bzlas pa ma zin gyi bar du 'od zer gyi spro bsdu du ma byas te/ lan cig byed pa lta bu ni ma yin no// yang 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don bya ba la gnyis te/ phan 'dogs pa dang*/ tshar gcod pa'o// dang po phan 'dogs na/ 'od des sems can la phog pas sems can nad dang gdon gyis nyen pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad bsal te bde ba la dgod pa'o// tshar gcod na 'od 'phros pas bsgrub bya gdug pa can dgra bgegs dmigs pa'i yul du byas la/

'od phog pas bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar tshig par bsam/ tshur 'dus thugs ka'i yi ge la phog thams cad bkrag dang gzi mdangs dang ldan par bsam mo// 'od zer phyogs bcur phar 'phros/ tshur 'dus du ma bya'o// lag len la rang gi sngags brjod pas sngar gyi spyan drangs pa'i phyag na rdo rje dpag tu med pa rnams dang*/ mdun du bsgoms pa thams cad ngang ngur mtsho khar lhags pa lta bu'am/ kun dga' ra bar mi mang pos klog 'don byed pa bzhin/ di ri ri brjod par bsam mo// bcu gcig pa chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ bzlas pa zin pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// zhes pa nas/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar// zhes pa'i bar brjod do// bcu gnyis pa brtan par bya ba ni/ thun mtshams su yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas brtan par bya'o// bcu gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod pas spyan drangs pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ bcu bzhi pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi de rang gi snying gar bsdu'o// bco lnga pa bsrung ba bya ba ni bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ring lan gsum mam/ bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su reg par byas la/ bsrung bar bya'o// de ltar byas pas rang don mi chod pa la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan don sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa la sogs pa 'grub pa'o// dmigs pa lha la gtad pa'o// gnyis pa dmigs pa gtor ma la gtad pa ni/ gtor ma bshams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ tshad med pa dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i thugs kar sngags bkod/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs/ de'i thugs kar sngags bkod/ de nas bzlas pa gang rung zlos shing*/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas pa byed pa lngar dang khyad par med/ khyad par du sngags kyi 'od zer gtor ma la zug nang du lhung bas gtor ma de rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po cig tu bsam/

gtor ma'i rdzas bdud rtsir bsams la/ ze'u'i nang du 'o ma lud pa ltar dkar mer gyis song bas/ gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ reg bya 'jam pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed yod pa thams cad nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsam zhing*/ sngags bzlas pa'i 'od zer phar 'phros gtor ma la phog pas 'o ma lud pa ltar bsam/ 'od de las mchod pa sna tshogs byung*/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'phags pa rnams mchod/ tshur 'dus thugs ka'i yi ge la thim/ yi ge thams cad bkrag dang gzi mdangs dang ldan par bsam mo// de ltar 'das pa rnams mchod nas/ 'jig rten pa rnams mchod pa ni/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs la sogs pas bsngo/ phyogs skyong so so'i snying po brjod/ sngags kyis bsngo/ bstod pa byas la phrin las gzhol lo// sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// zhes pa la sogs pa brjod/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ spyan drangs pa gshegs su gsol/ mdun gyi de rang la bsdu'o// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ngo*// gsum pa dmigs pa bum pa la gtad pa ni/ gser dngul lam zangs las byas pa'i bum pa chu bre gang shong ba yan chad gtsang ba mi gnag pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid gzhan dang 'dra ba'i nang du tsan+dan gyis sbyar ba'i chu srog chags med pas bkang*/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ snying po lnga rnams gzhug dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhan nas bshad pa yod kyang bzang la/ gzhung 'di ltar byas na mi dgos/ me tog sngon po dang yungs kar bcug ras gtsang mas mgul pa bcings/ rtsa dūr bas kha brgyan/ steng du rdo rje la gzungs thag btags la gzhag de gdan maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa gtsang ma'i steng du bzhag la/ bdag gis skyabs 'gro nas bzung nas bzlas pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra bar bya/

khyad par du gzungs thag nas bzung nas sngags gsum ka tshang ba'i rtsa sngags zlos na nyer gcig snying po'am nye snying zlos na brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// sngags bzlas pa'i dus su rang dang*/ mdun du spyan drangs pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer phar 'phros/ tshur 'dus pas bum pa'i nang du song ste/ bum pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod du gyur/ chu la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams 'o ma blugs pa ltar dkar me re re khengs te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur nas/ rnam pa rdo rje'i rdul phra rab las grub pa'i chu kha dog dkar por bsam zhing*/ 'od kyi 'phro 'dus 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ bum par song*/ rang gi thugs kar zhugs pas/ yi ge thams cad bkrag dang gzi mdangs dang ldan par bsam zhing bzlas la/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// zhes pa la sogs pa brjod nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ba'i bar snga ma bzhin bya'o// bzhi pa dmigs pa sbyin sreg la gtad pa ni/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i thab khung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ mchod pa lnga bsham/ bsreg rdzas yungs kar la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs bsham/ bdag nyid dmigs pa lha la gtad pa bzhin/ rang dang thab tu bskyed la/ gzungs lan bdun bzlas/ de nas me lha mdun bskyed thab tu bsams pa yang snying la gsum bzlas te/ mar gyi dgang blugs lan gsum dbul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams nad dang gdon la sogs par bsams la/ nye snying lan bdun bzlas te/ nad thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du gdon dang*/ rims dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ sems kyi g.yeng ba la sogs log 'dren dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba gza' dang rgyu skar gyi nyes pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa gdags so// de bzhin du nye ba'i snying po lan gsum bzlas te/

nad dang gdon la sogs pa a pa na ye swā hā/ de bzhin du nad dang gdon la sogs pa las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ btags la thams cad la bsreg rdzas lan gsum gsum dbul lo// bsam pa ni thab kyi lha las 'od byung nas bsgrub bya'i lus la phog pas nad la sogs pa zhi bar bsam mo// de nas badz+ra muḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs thab kyi dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bsrung ba bya/ thab khung mi dmigs par byas la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// dmigs pa sbyin sreg la gtad pa'o// rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /ces bya ba las 'phros nas khrus bya ba yin no// khrus la gsum/ bsdus pa dang*/ 'bring po dang*/ rgyas pa'o// dang po bsdus pa ni/ khrus byed pa'i skyes bu sngon la ngan khrus byas la/ de nas yang snying zlos shing*/ bum chus khrus bya'o// 'bring po ni ngan khrus kyi rjes la/ yang snying zlos shing gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ de nas yang snying zlos shing*/ zhi ba dang*/ byabs pa dang*/ bsrung ba gsum 'og tu byed pa bzhin bya'o// rgyas par byed na bum pa'i bzlas pa zin nas nyams su blang ba la don bcu gsum ste/ khrus kyis skyes bu ngan khrus bya ba dang*/ khrus sa'i stegs bur bzhag pa dang*/ khro bo la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ khu tshur gyis byur bsal ba dang*/ pra tsa tas gtor ba dang*/ zhi bar bya ba dang*/ byabs pas bsal ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ rdo rje'i go chas bsrung ba dang*/ srung ba chen pos bsrung ba dang*/ bi shwa badz+ras bsrung ba dang*/ bden pa'i stobs dang shis pa brjod de khrus sa nas dbyung ba'i cho ga'o// de la dang po chu gtsang mas ngan khrus byed du gzhug go /gnyis pa ni khrus sa'am stegs bu gtsang ma'am/ stan gtsang ma la kha shar du bstan la bzhag go

/gsum pa ni rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang spyan snga ru// gdug pa 'dul phyir rdo rje can gyis ni// rjes mthun phrin las khyad par gang bsgo ba// dam bcas phrin las de yi rjes dgongs la// de phyir bgegs dang log 'dren tshar gcod cing*// 'gro ba 'di la rjes su gzung ba'i phyir// sdug bsngal nges bsal bde mchog sbyor ba'o// khro rgyal khyod kyis deng 'dir byin rlabs mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab bo// bzhi pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad pa ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣ+ṭo t+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la dha rā ya/ pa ra shu pā sho hastā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ binā ya kanā na/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ dzī bī ta an+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ phyag rgya ni mthe'u chung bsnol ba'i steng du srin lag gis mnan la/ de'i rtse mo mthe bos mnan/ gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i rgyab nas mdzub mo gnyis kyis rdo rje'i rwa ltar byas pa'o// lan gsum mam bdun bzlas pas bgegs bskrad par bya'o// lnga pa khu tshur gyis byur bsal ba ni gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra dha ma dha ma hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa ya bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas so// drug pa pra tsa tas gtor ba ni/ yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ oṃ pra tsa ta ku pi tsa ta pa ti uk+ṣi pa la dha ra dha ra ṇi/ bha ra bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā bid+yā s+ya/ mahā bid+yā rā dzā s+ya/ tad+ya thā/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā kro dhā/ mu ru mu ru/ sarba bigh+nān bi nā ya ka ma tha ma tha/ pra hā ra pra hā ra/

sarba duṣ+ṭā na yan+t+ra ka pa ta na bi nā sha ya bhasmi ku ru/ da ha da ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ nirma thā/ nirma thā/ mahā kro dha dza ya dza ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān pa ti ka dz+wa la dz+wa la swā hā/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum du bzlas so// bdun bzhi par bya ba/ lag pa gnyis mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan/ sor mo gsum rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas pas g.yas pas rdo rje/ g.yon pas rma bya'i sgro 'dzin pas yang snying gi sham du gzhan btags la bzlas te/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nān shīn+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du kun la sbyar te/ mgo ru yang snying*/ bar du nad la sogs pa'i ming*/ mjug tu shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa btags la zhi bar bya'o// de yang nad la sogs pa'i ming ni/ sarba bigh+nān/ sarba byā dhi bh+yaḥ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥ sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu bh+yaḥ sarba gra he bh+yaḥ sarba dzā re bh+yaḥ sarba tā la pa ne bh+yaḥ sarba dur+sob+ne bh+yaḥ sarba durmit+te bh+yaḥ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ de rnams bod skad du byas kyang btub ste/ nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba lta bu'o// brgyad pa byabs la bsal ba ni/ sngar gyi rdo rje dang rma bya'i sgros nad la sogs pa thams cad bsal bar bsam/ yang snying gi mjug tu/ nad la sogs pa'i ming gi rjes la/ sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes btags la bzlas te/ de yang na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa bzlas so// dgu pa bsrung ba bya ba ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ yang snying ga'i rjes su gzhan btags la bzlas/ de yang na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ nad thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa brjod cing*/

sngar gyi gdon la sogs pa las bsrung bar bya'o// bcu pa rdo rje go chas bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgyas rim pa bzhin du/ snying ga mgrin pa/ smin mtshams/ dpung pa gnyis/ spyi bo dang lngar gtugs la sngags bzlas so// phyag rgya ni thal mo sbyar te/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar te/ mthe bong gnyis gung mo la sbyar bas/ na mas+sa man+ta badz+rā nāṃ/ badz+ra ka ba tse hūm̐/ zhes pas bsrung*/ bcu gcig pa bsrung ba chen po'i sngags dang phyag rgyas bsrung ste/ phyag rgya ni thal mo sbyar te/ mdzub mo gnyis nang du bkug la/ gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ srin lag brkyang*/ mthe'u chung gnyis cung zad bkug la/ mthe bong gnyis la tsa bsam/ gung mo gnyis la ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la pa bsam/ mthe'u chung gnyis la k+ṣa bsam/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ rak+ṣa ma hā ba le sarba ta thā ga te phu sa nirdza te hūm̐ hūm̐/ tra tha tra tha/ a pra ti ha te swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod cing*/ lag pa'i yi ge las 'od 'phros pas bgegs dang log 'dren byer nas/ bsgrub bya la srung ba chen po byas par bsgom mo// bcu gnyis pa sngar brjod pa'i gnas lngar rdo rje rgya gram de bzhag cing*/ oṃ bi shwa badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// bcu gsum pa bden pa'i stobs dang shis pa brjod de/ khrus sa nas dbyung ba ni/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing*/ khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs kyis// 'gro ba 'di la nga yis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring ba dang nad med phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog gis nges par 'byung ba ste// de kun khyed la deng 'dir 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ de nas khrus kyi skyes bu thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rdo rje 'dzin du bcug la/

sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed// ces pa nas/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar// zhes pa'i bar brjod do// rdo rje khrus kyis skyes bu khrus sa nas phyung la/ yon bdag gis yon phul nas/ ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o// bum pa dang 'brel ba'i khrus kyi cho ga'o// dpal ldan rgyud kun rtsa ba'i gsal byed 'di// bla mas mdzad la kho bos gzhan gyi phyir// lag tu blang ba'i rim pa gsal bgyis pa'i// dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi gsal byed 'od zer can zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo 'di la gnyis te/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rgyud dngos so// dang po la lnga ste/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ sdud pa po/ dus/ ston pa/ gnas so// rgyud dngos la lnga ste/ yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par dang ldan pa dang*/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi dngos dang*/ yon tan gyi 'bras bu phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa'i thabs 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan pa dang*/ bum pa'i cho ga bstan pa'o// yon tan rnams mthu dang byin rlabs las 'byung ba bstan pa dang*/ yon tan gyi mtshan rang don gyi mtshan khyad par can bstan pa dang*/ mtshan gyi sgo nas 'joms par byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ yon tan gyi gzhi dngos so// de la gsum ste rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ yang snying ngo*// phan yon 'bras bu dang bcas pa la gnyis te/ sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa dang*/ bde ba skyed par byed pa'o// sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa'i thabs 'bras bu dang bcas pa la bzhi ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rtags dang*/ de sel bar byed pa'i thabs mdo nyan pa dang*/
de rnams kyi phan yon bstan pa'o// rdzogs so// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
